name: MovieChat-1K
description: MovieChat-1K is a benchmark consisting of 1,000 long videos with 14,000 manual annotations designed to validate methods for long video understanding using integrated video foundation models and large language models.
reputation: A recent benchmark for long-video understanding that is gaining attention in multimodal research, but is still relatively new.
notes: Benchmark supports evaluation of long video understanding with a memory mechanism inspired by the Atkinson-Shiffrin memory model.
